$comment: S04 Open-Meteo CAMS air-quality estimates (T050). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s04.yaml.

fields.name: cell_id
fields.meaning: om_cams_global_<lat>N_<lon>E, the CAMS grid point the API snapped to

fields.name: product
fields.meaning: cams_global, the domain requested by name (a model estimate, not a CPCB observation)

fields.name: pm25_ugm3
fields.meaning: pm2_5 in μg/m³, instant value close to the surface

fields.name: pm10_ugm3
fields.meaning: pm10 in μg/m³, instant value close to the surface

fields.name: no2_ugm3
fields.meaning: nitrogen_dioxide in μg/m³, instant value close to the surface

issued_at: last_run_initialisation_time from data/cams_global/static/meta.json, read before and after the call
available_at: the later of last_run_availability_time + 10 minutes and the fetch time
missing: An hour with any pollutant missing becomes an all-null row with missing_reason out_of_coverage; a negative value makes the row quality_rejected
